text_block_list.text:
I head up to the roof to have a lunch
meeting
with Марузенски. Suddenly, we
hear a small cry
nearby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that voice?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: What are you doing there, Rice?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Марузенски!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, well... I'm the last robber, you
see...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
When I ask her about it, she tells us that
she's
playing cops and robbers with her
friends, and
she's the last robber left.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If I go to help, I might get caught! But I
don't
want to let my team down since
they invited me
to play...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, I see. So you're worried you might
lose.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски looks down at what appears
to be
the "jail" near the center of the
courtyard.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Rice, how many cops are there?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Umm... I think there's only one...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect! Let an old hand give you a
surefire
strategy, then! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Would you prefer the more physical Plan
A or the
strategic Plan B?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I-I have to choose?! Err... well...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Um, which do you think is better?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: All righty, then! ♪ Let's go with Plan A!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Keep the cop right on your tail, and
make them
chase you until they run out
of energy!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Do you think I'll be able to m-manage
that?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can! I know how strong you
are, Rice.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You're a hard worker, and I'm really
proud of your
perseverance.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
With the Maruzen seal of approval, rest
assured
you've got this in the bag!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Your seal of approval...
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll... I'll do it!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! This game gives me an idea for
some
good stamina training! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
All righty, then! ♪ Let's go with the
more tactical
Plan B!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Lure the cop toward the school
buildings, then
lose them in a dead end!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: D-do you really think I can do that?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Sure you can! You're great at planning
and
strategy, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
As she says this, Марузенски holds Rice
Shower's
hands tightly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's going to be fine if you keep a cool
head and
think things through, okay?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: ...Okay! I'll... I'll do it!
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I should probably follow my own
advice
now that I've said it, huh?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we watch from the rooftop as
Rice
Shower successfully saves her
friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

Afterward, we watch from the rooftop as
Rice
Shower successfully saves her
friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
